description: This C# source file defines the 'LineGetter' class within the PdfSharp testing helper library, specifically for iterating and extracting line element information from a content stream in a PDF processing context. It contains methods to identify 'l' command elements in the stream and retrieve their associated line coordinates, including a nested 'LineInfo' class that encapsulates the line's start and end points.

classes.name: LineGetter
classes.description: A class that iterates over content stream elements to locate and extract line segment information, based on 'l' commands in PDF content streams.

classes.name: LineGetter.LineInfo
classes.description: A class representing the start and end points of a line extracted from a PDF content stream, with coordinate strings and parsed double values.

methods.name: IdentifyingElementCheck
methods.description: Checks if the current content stream element is an 'l' command, indicating a line segment.

methods.name: GetObject
methods.description: Retrieves the coordinates of a line segment before an 'l' command by moving backward through the content stream.

methods.name: CreateLineInfo
methods.description: Static factory method that creates a 'LineInfo' instance if the coordinate strings can be parsed into doubles.
